scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Why are you carrying so many items?
Are you in a training course or something?
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
你怎么带了这么多东西？
在参加什么训练吗？

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Lu~lu~lu~lu~
Lu~ Huh?
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
卢~卢~卢~卢~
卢~ 嗯？

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Wow, you must be a beginner, right?
What an innocent face! Ha~ hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
哇，你一定是新手吧？
这张脸真天真！哈~哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Why don't you do some hunting outside instead of walking around and wasting your time?
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
与其四处闲逛浪费时间，不如去外面打猎呢。

scripts.text: I am about to leave now.
scripts.translation: 我正要离开

scripts.text: I've got a Hunting Mission.
scripts.translation: 我接了狩猎任务

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Oh, well. Then, go figure.
Bye~ bye.
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
好吧，随你。
再见~

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Oh, you are from the Eden Group?
What mission do you have?
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
哦，你是乐园团的？
你有什么任务？

scripts.text: Hunting Poison Spore
scripts.translation: 狩猎毒魔菇

scripts.text: Hunting Smokie
scripts.translation: 狩猎狸猫

scripts.text: Hunting Elder Willow
scripts.translation: 讨伐长老树精

scripts.text: Hunting Coco
scripts.translation: 讨伐可可

scripts.text: Hunting Thara Frog
scripts.translation: 讨伐达拉蛙

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
{0}!
Wow, I didn't expect you would do that mission. I was just about to give up. But you did good job. I appreciate it!
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
{0}！
没想到你会接这个任务。我本来都快放弃了。你做得真不错，谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Well, I requested the mission and you did an excellent job.
I will give you a reward as I promised.
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
我发布了任务，你也出色地完成了。
我会兑现承诺，给你奖励。

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Here it is. Thank you very much. God bless you!
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
给你。非常感谢。愿上帝保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Oh, you are right.
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
哦，你说得对。

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
But, you haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come to me now? You haven't completed the mission!
I will give you a reward if you complete the mission. Ok? Are we good?
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
可你还没完成任务，怎么现在就回来了？
完成之后我才会给你奖励，明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Anyway, I will be here waiting for you. Please come back when you finish the mission!
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
总之，我会在这里等你。完成任务后请回来找我！

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Huh? Are you sure? Something is wrong...
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
咦？你确定吗？哪里不对劲...

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
It is weird.
Please check your Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
真奇怪。
请按“Alt + U”查看任务窗口。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Why are you carrying so many items?
Are you in a training course or something?
scripts.translation:
[迪辛快递员]
你怎么带了这么多东西？
在参加什么训练吗？

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Hu hu~~ we are delivery men~
We are faster than any flight~!
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
呼呼~~ 我们是快递员~
我们比任何飞行都更快~！

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Welcome~ welcome!
We are the fastest delivery company, Dieshin Corperation.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛快递员]
欢迎~欢迎！
我们是最快的快递公司——迪辛公司。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[迪辛快递员]
有什么需要帮忙的吗？

scripts.text: I don't need help.
scripts.translation: 我不需要帮忙

scripts.text: I've got a Delivery Mission.
scripts.translation: 我接了配送任务

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Oh, well. Then, go figure. Bye~!
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
哦，好吧。那就随你吧。再见~！

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Oh, you are from the Eden Group?
What mission do you have?
scripts.translation:
[迪辛快递员]
哦，你是乐园团的？
接了什么任务？

scripts.translation: 配送杀虫剂

scripts.text: Deliver Honey.

scripts.text: Deliver Blankets.
scripts.translation: 配送毛毯

Huh? Are you sure? Something is wrong...
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Wait, but you already have a delivery box.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛快递员]
等等，你已经有一个配送箱了。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
We can't allow you to deliver two boxes at once. So, please finish your delivery first.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛快递员]
一次不能送两个箱子，请先完成手头的配送任务。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
If you forgot where to deliver, then please check Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛快递员]
忘了送货地点的话，请按“Alt + U”查看任务窗口。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Ah ha! I got it!
The insecticide? It must be the Zoologist on the southeast of Payon who ordered the Insecticide.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛快递员]
啊哈！想起来了！
杀虫剂？应该是斐扬东南方那位动物学家订购的。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Ah ha! I got it!
Honey? It must be the Entomologist at the west of St. Capitolina Abbey, wich is northeast of Prontera who ordered the Honey.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛快递员]
啊哈！想起来了！
蜂蜜？应该是普隆德拉东北方圣卡普蒂娜修道院西边的昆虫学家订购的。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Oh, Right!
The blankets! It must be the biologist in the south of Lutie field who ordered the blankets.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛快递员]
哦，对了！
毯子！应该是姜饼城野外南边的生物学家订购的。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
You can can go to Lutie by asking Mr. Claus in the northeastern part of Al De Baran.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛快递员]
要去姜饼城，可以找艾尔帕兰东北方的克劳斯先生。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Dieshin's cooperation motive is to give the fastest and credited delivery. So please deliver it now without any delay.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛快递员]
迪辛公司的宗旨是快速、可靠地送货。现在就出发，别耽搁。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
If you forgot where to make the delivery, then please check the Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛快递员]
忘了送货地点的话，请按“Alt + U”查看任务窗口。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Why are you carrying so many items?
Are you in a training course or something?
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
你为什么带着这么多东西？
是在参加什么训练课程吗？

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Have you heard of a monster named Bigfoot?
It looks like a bear with red fur and has a 'X' shape scar on his shoulder.
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
你听说过大脚怪吗？
它长得像红毛熊，肩上有一道X形伤疤。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
According to the recent research, flies and Bigfoot monsters have a symbiotic relationship.
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
根据最近的研究，苍蝇和大脚怪之间存在共生关系。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
I am currently studying about it and try to prove the theory. So I plan to kill the flies around Bigfoot and observe his reaction.
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
我正在研究并尝试验证这个理论，所以打算消灭大脚怪周围的苍蝇，观察它的反应。

scripts.text: ...I am not interested.
scripts.translation: ...我没兴趣

scripts.text: Here is the Insecticide.
scripts.translation: 杀虫剂在这里

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Oh, I need an Insecticide to continue the study.
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
哦，我需要杀虫剂才能继续研究。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Huh?
You are not Dieshin's delivery man?
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
咦？
你不是迪辛的快递员吗？

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
I am waiting for a special delivery.
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
我在等一个特别的快递。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Oh ho! Yes! That one!
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
哦！对对对！就是这个！

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
That is the Insecticide that I ordered! You were sent by Dieshin right?
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
这就是我订购的杀虫剂！你是迪辛派来的吧？

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
I have been waiting for this!
Give it to me!
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
我等了很久了！
快给我！

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
It arrived much faster than I thought. I want to test it right away!
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
比我想的快多了。我想马上测试一下！

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Well done. Good Job! Thank you so much! Here is a little gift for you.
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
干得好！非常感谢！这是给你的一点谢礼。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
I appreciate your kindness.
But, what did you bring?
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
谢谢你的好意。
不过，你带了什么来？

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Hmm, I thought that Dieshin was fast and accurate, but you brought me an empty box. How disappointing.
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
我以为迪辛又快又准，没想到你送来的是空箱子。真让人失望。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Please bring my order. Dieshin will give you my product.
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
请把我的订单送来，迪辛会把货物交给你。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

Here is some hair~ a broken clock~!

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Hey~! Dude! You look like a very rich adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
嘿~！伙计！你看起来像个很有钱的冒险者。

scripts.text: I am a poor adventurer.
scripts.translation: 我是个贫穷的冒险者

scripts.text: I have a gathering mission.
scripts.translation: 我有一个采集任务

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Really? Hmm, oh right. You don't look sophisticated.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
真的吗？嗯，对了。你看起来不太讲究。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You are a poor adventurer~! Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你是个贫穷的冒险者~！祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Oh, you are from the Eden Group?
What mission do you have?
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
哦，你是乐园团的？
接了什么任务？

scripts.text: Gather Bones
scripts.translation: 采集骨头

scripts.text: Gather Animal Skin
scripts.translation: 采集动物外皮

scripts.text: Gather Peelings
scripts.translation: 采集果皮

scripts.text: Gather Tails
scripts.translation: 采集尾巴

scripts.text: Gather Cookies
scripts.translation: 采集绿饼人

scripts.text: Gather Mustaches
scripts.translation: 采集胡子

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Skel-Bones?
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
看来你接了采集任务。
不过，邪骸骨在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你还没做任务呢。为什么又回到这里？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You don't have enough 'Skel-Bones'... You can find it when you hunt Skeletons.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你的“骷髅骨”不够... 打邪骸战士可以掉落。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
To find Skeletons, you better check Payon Dungeon 1F, which is located in Archer Village, north of Payon.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
想找邪骸骨，去斐扬北边弓箭手村的斐扬地下城一楼看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where is the Bear's Footskins and Animal Skins?
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
我看你有采集任务。
但是，熊掌和动物外皮在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你还没做任务呢。为什么又回到这里？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You have to bring 10 Bear's Footskins' and '5 Animal Skins!
You can find Bear's Footskin from Bigfoot and Animal Skin from Animals.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
带10个熊掌和5张动物外皮来！
熊掌由大脚怪掉落，动物外皮则由各种动物掉落。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Bigfoot is around the north of Geffen field or the southeast of Payon field.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
大脚怪在吉芬野外北部或斐扬野外东南部附近。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Worm Peelings and Garlets?
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
看来你接了采集任务。
不过，虫皮和加勒结晶呢？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You have to bring '20 Worm Peelings' and '20 Garlets' to complete the mission.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你需要带20个虫皮和20个加勒结晶来完成这个任务。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You can get those items from 'Piere', 'Andre', 'Deniro', 'Vitata', 'Thief Bug', 'Female Thief Bug' and 'Male Thief Bug'.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你可以从工蚁、白蚁、兵蚁、黑蚁、浮勒盗虫、雌性浮勒盗虫和雄性浮勒盗虫身上获得这些物品。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
'Piere', 'Andre', 'Deniro' and 'Vitata' are in Ant Hell which is located near the Saint Darmain Fortress soutwest of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
工蚁、白蚁、兵蚁和黑蚁都在蚂蚁地狱，那里位于摩洛克西南方的圣达姆安要塞附近。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
'Thief Bug', 'Female Thief Bug' and 'Male Thief Bug' are int he Prontere Culvert. To get there, you need to be a volunteer of the Prontera Culvert's punitive force.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
盗虫、雌性盗虫和雄性盗虫都在普隆德拉下水道。要进去，你得成为下水道讨伐队的志愿者。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Yoyo Tails, Acorns and Raccoon Leafs?
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
看来你接了采集任务。
不过，溜溜猴尾巴、橡果和狸猫树叶呢？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
You have to bring '10 Yoyo Tails,' '10 Acorns' and '10 Raccoon Leafs' to complete the mission.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你还没做任务呢。为什么又回到这里？
你需要带10个溜溜猴尾巴、10个橡果和10个变身叶子来完成这个任务。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You can get Yoyo Tails from 'Yoyo's', Acorn from 'Coco's' and Raccoon Leaf from 'Smokies'.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
溜溜猴尾巴可以从溜溜猴身上获得，橡果可以从可可身上获得，变身叶子可以从狸猫身上获得。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You can find them easily around fields, but the field east of Ayothaya is the best spot for hunting all 3 monsters.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
野外到处都有这些魔物，不过哎哟泰雅东边的野外最适合一次狩猎这三种。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
To get to Ayothaya, you better go to 'Aibakthing' in Alberta and pay his fare.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
要去哎哟泰雅，可以到艾尔贝塔找艾巴克辛并支付船费。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Well-baked Cookies and the Piece of Cake?
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
看来你接了采集任务。
不过，烤饼干和蛋糕呢？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
You have to bring '5 Well-baked Cookies' and '1 Piece of Cake' to complete the mission.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你还没做任务呢。为什么又回到这里？
你需要带5个姜饼和1个小蛋糕来完成这个任务。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You can get Well-baked Cookie from 'Cookies' who wears red or green shirts.
For getting Piece of Cake, you should look for 'Mystcases'.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
穿红衣或绿衣的绿饼人会掉落烤饼干。
蛋糕则可以从神秘箱身上获得。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Both monsters canbe found in the Toy Factory Warehouse or Toy Monitoring Room. To get there, ask Mr. Claus in the northeastern part of Al De Baran.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
这两种魔物都在玩具工厂仓库或玩具监控室。去艾尔帕兰东北边找克劳斯先生问路吧。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Mole Whiskerss and Mole Claws??
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
看来你接了采集任务。
不过，土拨鼠的胡须和爪子呢？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
You have to bring '5 Mole Whiskers' and '3 Mole Claws' to complete the mission.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你还没做任务呢。为什么又回到这里？
你需要带5个鼠须和3个鼠指甲来完成这个任务。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You can get those items from 'Martins'.
Martins can be found in the Mjolnir Dead Pit, but the second floor is dangerous, so be careful!
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
土拨鼠会掉落这些物品。
妙勒尼尔死亡之坑里就有土拨鼠，不过二楼很危险，要小心！

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
To get there, ask a Kafra Employee in Geffen, they can warp you there.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
去吉芬找卡普拉职员，他们可以把你传送过去。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Anyway, I will be here waiting for you. Please come back when you finish the mission!
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
总之，我会在这里等你。完成任务后请回来找我！

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Huh? Are you sure? Something is wrong...
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
咦？你确定吗？好像哪里不对劲...

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
It is weird.
Please check your Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
真奇怪。
请按“Alt + U”检查任务窗口。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Wow~ you did an excellent job!
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
哇~干得真漂亮！

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Thank you very much. God bless you!
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
非常感谢。愿上帝保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Ha~! Ha~!
I will give you a reward as promised.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
哈~！哈~！
我会按承诺给你奖励。
